lines.text: Did you know? Fact is Latin for make or do.
Effect: out plus make or do.
Factory: a place where things are made.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus make or do?
Effect! Out plus make or do.

words.mean: what is made out of a cause
words.ex: Too much screen time can have a negative effect on sleep.

words.mean: a place where things are made
words.ex: My uncle works in a shoe factory.
